features.name: My Air home screen (place cards, alerts, tasks)
features.summary: Hash-routed home page listing the person's pinned places as cards plus alerts and small daily tasks.

features.name: Monitor name, distance and reading age on every number
features.summary: Readings carry provenance (source, nearest monitor, age) and a trust label (Live/Estimate/Measured); stale readings are dropped.
features.registry_match: Monitor name, distance and reading age

features.name: Place detail (Today) screen
features.summary: Per-place screen with hero AQI, pollutants, hourly, daily, history, health and attribution components backed by /v1/today.

features.name: Exposure dial (24-hour, family members, outings)
features.summary: Screen computing the air a person breathed hour by hour across home/work/school/outdoor/measured, with people, outings log and week strip.

features.name: Ask assistant (English and Hindi, rules first)
features.summary: Floating assistant answers from fixed rules; Hindi answers are fixed wording, English may be reworded by the model.

features.name: Bedrock Nova Micro wording with number check, guardrail and kill switch
features.summary: Model only rewords or answers from facts; any number not in the facts makes the plain rule text go out; SSM kill switch and per-caller daily quota.

features.name: Spoken answers (Polly Kajal, browser TTS, speech recognition)
features.summary: POST /v1/speech synthesises English/Hindi via Polly with quotas; web falls back to SpeechSynthesis and supports SpeechRecognition input.

features.name: Tell assistant about an outing (e.g. walked 40 minutes)
features.summary: Parses free text outings from the assistant into exposure outings.

features.name: Request a demo or monitors form
features.summary: Form posting to /v1/requests, stored in DynamoDB with daily hash quota.

features.name: ESP32-S3 + SPS30 room sensor firmware (BLE)
features.summary: Arduino sketch reads Sensirion SPS30 over UART and notifies an 18-byte PM packet over BLE about every 2 s.
features.registry_match: ESP32-S3 room sensor and DIY air cleaner

features.name: Web Bluetooth connection and packet protocol
features.summary: Browser connects to the Vayu- unit, parses packets and feeds readings and measured hours into the app.
features.registry_match: ESP32-S3 room sensor and DIY air cleaner

features.name: Your room screen (indoor vs outdoor, purifier/window test)
features.summary: Shows unit reading against outside air, advice, live chart and a marked-moment test of how far PM2.5 moved and time to halve.
features.registry_match: ESP32-S3 room sensor and DIY air cleaner

features.name: DIY air cleaner prototype and CADR calculator
features.summary: Hardware build documented in docs/PURIFIER.md; only code is an unused CADR fitDecay helper, no control firmware (cleaner does not switch itself).
features.registry_match: ESP32-S3 room sensor and DIY air cleaner

features.name: /v1/rooms unit readings store
features.summary: GET room route and DynamoDB room store exist, but no unit reports to AWS so it is unused in production.

features.name: Map of monitors, wind, fires and modelled air
features.summary: MapLibre map on OpenFreeMap tiles showing monitors, wind particles, FIRMS fires and a model grid fog.

features.name: Report a fire from the map
features.summary: Sheet with 112/101 emergency numbers and POST /v1/fire-reports storing a point and note for 180 days.

features.name: AIR Lens camera haze overlay
features.summary: getUserMedia rear camera with canvas particles scaled to the air quality and wind; sample scene when no camera.

features.name: Three-day alerts (GRAP band, smog, stubble fires, rain, wind)
features.summary: Rule-based alert generation with GRAP stage estimate per monitor and authorities sheet.

features.name: School assembly advice and daily tasks
features.summary: Computes whether morning assembly should be indoors and creates school tasks from air over school hours.

features.name: Walk window finder and 3-day timeline
features.summary: Core builds hourly timeline, pattern forecast, cleanest window and headline; served via /v1/timeline.

features.name: Rule-based verdicts, walk advice, US AQI and WHO comparison
features.summary: Deterministic advice (walk/mask/windows), US AQI from PM2.5, WHO guideline comparison, rules loaded from JSON.

features.name: Recorded days (/#/week, seven real past days)
features.summary: Same app replayed on prepared real archive days via S3-backed /v1/replay and a recorded air source.

features.name: Optional accounts with Cognito and saved-profile sync
features.summary: Email/password sign-in via Cognito, JWT-authorised /v1/me storing one profile in DynamoDB, account delete.

features.name: Add place by search, Detect my location, live location
features.summary: Place search (Open-Meteo/Photon geocoding), pinned places with roles and drag order, GPS detect and follow.

features.name: Unit display options incl. cigarette equivalent
features.summary: Provider for AQI/PM display units and Berkeley Earth cigarette rule of thumb.

features.name: HTTP API router (health, places, today, timeline, history, fires, stations, wind, airgrid, replay)
features.summary: Dependency-injected router behind API Gateway Lambda with zod contracts, caching headers and 404 for unwired routes.

features.name: 15-minute harvest job and 30-minute stations job
features.summary: EventBridge Scheduler Lambdas cache OpenAQ/Open-Meteo/FIRMS for reference places and map monitors into DynamoDB/S3.

features.name: OpenAQ, Open-Meteo, MET Norway and NASA FIRMS clients
features.summary: Provider repos with caching and fallback (Open-Meteo then MET Norway wind).

features.name: Telegram bot webhook and chat linking
features.summary: Secret-verified POST webhook handles link codes and acks; sends are switched off and no screen links a chat.

features.name: Alert loop (Step Functions, Telegram send step, Hindi voice)
features.summary: State machine with send step, task-token resume on first tap and SSM sends-enabled flag; built and tested against fakes, not live.

features.name: "Did it work?" fix-check workflow
features.summary: POST /v1/fixchecks starts a Step Functions run comparing room air before/after; no web screen calls it.

features.name: IoT Core rule, Firehose and Athena analytics
features.summary: Built and CDK-tested for device messaging but not used by the Bluetooth unit.

features.name: CloudFront + S3 site with /v1 passthrough
features.summary: Private bucket served via CloudFront distribution with security headers and API behaviour.

features.name: Alarms, dashboard, tracing, daily quotas and per-caller limits
features.summary: CloudWatch alarms/dashboard, X-Ray tracing, DynamoDB daily quota counters and hashed client address.

features.name: make prove bundle check and smoke/live checks
features.summary: Scripts that fail if fixtures reach the deployed bundle, plus smoke invariants and headless-Chrome live-check scripts.

features.name: Safety, claims, cost, as-built and boundary docs
features.summary: Documents listing every rule, public claim, cost cap and what is live versus not.
